stability_effect_rationale: The hook scales only high-norm slingshot episodes. In the executable state law impulse_scale falls from 1.0 to 0.25, so formation receives smaller rule-reorganizing impulses while stability burden accumulates four times more slowly and its thresholded transient degradations become less likely.

mechanism_state_change.expected_formation_effect: smaller episode gain and later sustained crossing
mechanism_state_change.expected_stability_effect: smaller burden increments and fewer threshold discharges
